name: Group Bulk Operations
description: Adds core Views bulk-form actions for the Group module: assign a group role, remove a member, or change the owner across many groups at once via a batch.
project_description: Group Bulk Operations adds Group-entity actions to a Views bulk form so a site administrator can act on many groups at once instead of editing each group individually. It ships three core Action plugins of type 'group' — Assign group role, Remove group user, and Update group owner — plus a Views field handler (group_bulk_form) that extends core's BulkForm and is exposed on the 'groups' Views base table. Selecting groups in a view and running an action stashes the chosen group IDs into the current user's private tempstore and redirects to a configuration form (under /admin/group/*, all gated by the global 'administer group' permission) where the operator picks the target user(s) and, for role assignment, the roles. The form then runs a Batch API process that adds or re-adds the user as a member with the chosen roles, removes the member, or sets the group owner across every selected group. Depends on Group; works with core Views only (not the contrib Views Bulk Operations module).
